correctness.rationale: Fresh final dual-only statement rigorously follows: leaves a_n,b_1 are simplicial, so selecting both leaves a convex complement. Every general-position set of size>=3 is independent; if independent and a_i (i<n) selected, outside b_i,b_{i+1} have shortest path through a_i, contradicting convexity. Similarly selected b_j,j>1 is excluded. For size-2 same-shore and adjacent cross pairs, explicit outside-vertex geodesics exclude them; only nonadjacent pair {a_n,b_1} survives. Entire n>=4 is proved structurally; independent direct-definition exhaustive checks at n4,n5,n6 match, manuscript n7 checker also inspected. The full repaired RESULT and SLOGAN attribute prior MMD/outer results.
